overview: Safe counting is in the left menu. Its heading is 'Safe counting workspace'. It reviews safe counts, investigates differences and exports the complete evidence. Filters are Period, Day, Market and a Search by id, market or auditor, with Apply filters and an 'XLSX - Export all' button. Counters show Countings, Balanced, With difference and Total difference.

screenshots.alt: The Safe counting workspace in the MCL web platform
screenshots.description: The MCL web 'Safe counting workspace': filters for Period, Day, Market and Search, an XLSX Export all button, and counters for Countings, Balanced, With difference and Total difference.
